accent.description: Color for values, bars, and today's activity.
accent.label: Accent color

currency.description: Currency for displayed costs. Auto follows the interface language.
currency.label: Currency

pill_extras.description: What to show beside the percentage. Describes the window the bar metric tracks (the 5-hour one under “Both”).
pill_extras.label: Bar extras

pill_metric.description: Which rate window the bar pill shows.
pill_metric.label: Bar metric

pill_style.description: How the bar pill draws the utilization. The ring tracks the 5-hour window when the metric is “Both”.
pill_style.label: Bar style

refresh_interval.description: How often to fetch usage data (minutes).
refresh_interval.label: Refresh interval

ring_color.description: Used only when the palette cannot be read, as with built-in themes.
ring_color.label: Ring fallback color

ring_size.description: Ring diameter in pixels. Keep it under the bar height.
ring_size.label: Ring size

show_glyph.description: Only applies to the glyph + percentage style.
show_glyph.label: Show glyph
